scope: Corollary 5.7 (One-hole comparison) of the manuscript “Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap” (preprints/Uniform-Stability-of-the-Spherical-Laughlin-Gap-October-5-2026/uniform-stability-spherical-laughlin-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 269 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1bb20744f2bfa51), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose h = 1, equivalently q = 3n − 2. Let ψ, ϕ be any two unit vectors in Zn,q. Let {Ox} be a measurable family of neutral self-adjoint observables of norm at most one, supported in balls of a fixed radius r ≥ 2 about x, with center measure of bounded density. There are constants C, B′ < ∞, independent of n, q, such that Z |⟨ψ, Oxψ⟩ − ⟨ϕ, Oxϕ⟩| dx ≤ CrB′ . (5.17) The same conclusion holds for rapidly localized families, with the right side bounded by the corresponding fixed rapid-locality seminorm. For a family whose norms are bounded by A, multiply the right side by A.
